programs.title: My Penguin Friend
programs.desc: A heartbroken fisherman finds a penguin drifting alone in the ocean, drenched in oil from a spill. He not only rescues the sea creature, but takes it under his wing, finding a sense of joy for the first time in years.

programs.title: Strong Fathers, Strong Daughters
programs.desc: When a wealthy businessman learns of his daughter's engagement, he struggles to give up control and trust God with her future.

programs.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programs.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with a powerful faction of Transformers known as the Maximals to save Earth.

programs.title: Meadowlarks
programs.desc: Four siblings, torn apart by the Sixties Scoop, reunite for one week.

programs.title: Self Reliance
programs.desc: A man receives an offer to win $1 million by playing a game where he must outwit hunters who are trying to kill him. He soon realizes they can only attack him when he's alone, but none of his friends or family believe the game is real.

programs.title: Venom: The Last Dance
programs.desc: Eddie Brock and Venom must make a devastating decision as they're pursued by a mysterious military man and alien monsters from Venom's home world.

programs.title: Knock at the Cabin
programs.desc: While vacationing at a remote cabin in the woods, a young girl and her parents are taken hostage by four armed strangers who demand they make an unthinkable choice to avert the apocalypse. Confused, scared and with limited access to the outside world, the family must decide what they believe before all is lost.

programs.title: The Iron Claw
programs.desc: The true story of the Von Erich brothers, who, through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, seek epic immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

programs.title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
programs.desc: While hosting a gathering of the Association for the Study of American Archaeology, Emma Fielding is thrust into the middle of a murder mystery when the president of her organization is poisoned on the eve of announcing her successor.

programs.title: Air Bud: Golden Receiver
programs.desc: Teenager Josh (Kevin Zegers) just became the legal owner of his basketball-playing dog, Buddy. But now Buddy is playing football, too, thanks to veterinarian Patrick Sullivan (Gregory Harrison), who happens to be the new boyfriend of Josh's mom. Unfortunately, Josh and Patrick don't get along too well. But, when a couple of Russians (Nora Dunn, Perry Anzilotti) see Buddy playing on TV and decide to kidnap him for their circus, the two must band together to find the dog and save him.
